name: Broad except swallows a real failure
modeled_on: A bare `except Exception` catches a genuine failure and returns None, hiding the error. Real-world analogue: a fetch helper that swallows network/parsing errors and returns None, so callers can't tell a missing record from a broken backend.
hidden_bug: fetch_json() wraps the network call in `except Exception: return None`, so when the underlying client raises (e.g. HTTP 500, parse error), the failure is silently converted to None.
expected_behavior: fetch_json() must propagate the underlying exception instead of swallowing it.
ground_truth: Remove the broad except (or re-raise) so real failures are not silently turned into None.
